curl: /usr/bin/curl
wget: NOT FOUND
python3: NOT FOUND
pip3: NOT FOUND
node: NOT FOUND
npm: NOT FOUND
apt-get: /usr/bin/apt-get

gcc: NOT FOUND

observation.command: for c in curl wget python3 pip3 node npm apt-get make gcc g++; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$c: $(command -v $c)" || echo "$c: NOT FOUND"; done
